issue_context.title: Image created time and image save output different under containerd
issue_context.body:
### Description

With graphdrivers you can compare image.Created with the mod time of the image config in a saved tar.
We actually have a test for this in integration-cli.

With containerd these times are different: 

```
$ docker inspect -f '{{ .Created }}' busybox
0001-01-01T00:00:00Z
```

```
$ tar -tvf foo.tar 
drwxr-xr-x 0/0               0 1970-01-01 00:00 blobs/
drwxr-xr-x 0/0               0 1970-01-01 00:00 blobs/sha256/
-r--r--r-- 0/0         2592244 1970-01-01 00:00 blobs/sha256/4b35f584bb4f862773e2b84b827795b6f01985c7bcebb0696a3eb66318a166a5
-r--r--r-- 0/0            1457 1970-01-01 00:00 blobs/sha256/7cfbbec8963d8f13e6c70416d6592e1cc10f47a348131290a55d43c3acab3fb9
-r--r--r-- 0/0             528 1970-01-01 00:00 blobs/sha256/acaddd9ed544f7baf3373064064a51250b14cfe3ec604d65765a53da5958e5f5
-rw-r--r-- 0/0             368 1970-01-01 00:00 index.json
-rw-r--r-- 0/0             213 1970-01-01 00:00 manifest.json
-r--r--r-- 0/0              30 1970-01-01 00:00 oci-layout
```

### Reproduce

1. Inspect an image (e.g. busybox:latest), read the Created field
2. Save busybox:latest (`docker save busybox:latest`) and list the files in the tar (`tar -tv`)

With graphdrivers these times are the same, containerd they differ.

### Expected behavior

Based on the fact that we actually test for this, these values should be the same.

comments:
Opened a PR to fix the `Created` in `docker inspect`.

Still, there's the issue with the times in tar headers not being updated, but that needs to be fixed upstream, because containerd archive export code doesn't set them at all: https://github.com/containerd/containerd/blob/b16b0c872d3402d8e51499a30393f444f0f8f0e7/images/archive/exporter.go#L326-L331

review_comments: Should we fixate `time.Time()` either at the start of the loop, or before looping? (it looks like currently the history item and config both call this function, so would end up with different timestamps?

I'm not sure if I understand why do we want to fixate anything here.
This is just a helper to safely dereference `*time.Time` from `ocispec.Image`, so we just return a zero timestamp instead of panic because of nil dereference.
It's used for totally different timestamps (image config and individual entries from `History`).
🤦 for some reason I read `time.Time{}` as `time.Now()`, and thought we would be generating two timestamps

Ahhh, that makes sense now! 🤣 
I guess could have figured it out if I didn't misread `time.Time()` as `time.Time{}` 😄
